items.title: How many tests break when the internals change, but behavior doesn't?
items.description: Drag the number of tests written directly against internal state (like cart.items.length or cart.items[0]). Every one of them breaks on a purely internal refactor like the array-to-Map change in L3, regardless of how many there are — behavior-based tests, written against the public interface, stay at 0 broken no matter how many exist, since they never touch the internals in the first place. At 15, this reproduces L1's actual scenario.
